ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 30% high-intensity white pixels concentrated at the distal lateral margins versus 70% low-intensity black pixels across the central and proximal surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Distinct high-contrast white patches with internal black mottling are mapped to the distal lateral regions of both lobes; the central area and the region surrounding the median notch consist of solid, low-intensity black pixels.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep U-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 45 degrees and a bounding-box depth approximately 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; serrations appear deeper and more irregular on the left lobe compared to the right.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep along the trailing edge leading to sharp, upward-pointing lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of roughly circular, high-contrast, textured pixel clusters (barnacles) localized at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear marks; one prominent diagonal abrasion is visible on the lower-left quadrant of the left lobe, with several thinner horizontal rake marks distributed across the central black regions.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle colonization at the lateral tips and multiple linear rake-mark scars on the ventral surface pigmentation.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly unique 'spatter' pattern of white pigmentation on the distal third of each lobe, contrasting sharply with the solid black central regions.
